title: Local note: deep research spine
content: The local project spine is clarify and normalize, generate a research brief, plan subquestions, run concurrent researchers, deduplicate sources, synthesize cited claims, and run citation checks before returning a structured report.

title: Local note: observability
content: The local observability design records structured trace events for every stage and attributes estimated token usage and cost to brief generation, planning, and synthesis.

title: Local note: failure handling
content: The local failure handling design uses timeout budgets, bounded retries, a circuit breaker, and mock fallback search so external search errors do not block the main research workflow.

title: Local note: benchmark harness
content: The local benchmark harness records seed, configuration snapshot, latency, token estimates, source counts, citation retention rate, fallback count, success, and output summary for each case.

title: Local note: agentic RAG comparison
content: Normal RAG retrieves context once for a single answer, while this agentic RAG flow plans multiple subquestions, retrieves in parallel, filters evidence, and validates citations after synthesis.
